rationale: The plan correctly identifies the matrix as RSEM expected counts, states that the effective-length offset is lost without the genes.results files, rounds explicitly for DESeq2, never substitutes TPM/FPKM, and fits a ~condition Wald model with control as reference, median-of-ratios normalization, BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage, retaining sample_01 in the primary analysis with a pre-specified sensitivity run and a full VST PCA/distance/library-size QC. It falls short of the reference by explicitly forbidding any attempt to obtain the genes.results files rather than requesting them, and the |shrunken LFC| > 1 subset is a post hoc filter rather than a threshold inside the test. Enrichment was not asked but is specified well (full ranked list by Wald statistic, tested-gene universe, named human collections, 15-500 size window), though collection versions are not stated; the report lists packages but never commits to reporting software versions.
